slides.texte_overlay:
Things every man
should own by 30

1. One good watch

Not expensive. Reliable.
You'll wear it for years.

2. Leather shoes you can polish

For the days that matter.

3. A cast-iron pan

It lasts a lifetime
if you look after it.

4. Jumper cables in your car

You'll help a stranger one day.

5. A habit of learning
every day

The best thing you'll ever own.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. A habit of learning
every day

Mine: 5 minutes a day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
6. One great winter coat

Buy once, cry once.
